channels.agency: Oregon Department of Environmental Quality (Oregon Emergency Response System)
channels.name: Oregon Emergency Response System and DEQ (spill and overflow reports)
channels.legal_basis: DEQ permit general conditions (NPDES Schedule F, D.5): an oral report within 24 hours to the Oregon Emergency Response System (1-800-452-0311) and a written report to DEQ within five days (DEQ's Sanitary Sewer Overflow Report Form); OAR 340-142-0040: a reportable spill is reported to OERS immediately
channels.note: Reported by telephone only (OERS, 1-800-452-0311) within 24 hours, and on DEQ's paper form within five days. Neither is published: DEQ's layer of the spills it verified stops at 2025-03-27 (or-deq-oers-spills-archive) and no successor was found. Every Oregon permittee, public or private, reports this way.

channels.name: Oregon DEQ: spills reported to OERS and verified by DEQ, 2013 to March 2025
channels.note: A frozen ArcGIS layer of every spill reported to OERS and verified by DEQ, 2013-07-24 to 2025-03-27: 2,371 sewage spills with DEQ's point, the report date and time and gallons.
